title: Current batch manifest
notes: Authoritative current batch list for Tower. Every item in this file is shown in the Batch Task Table, sorted by order — there is no fixed row limit. Planned rows (no matching live job) stay static with blue Next/Queued or yellow Waiting labels until linked. Live rows carry a · live marker and sync from command-channel job state. Green = only a matched job that is claimed/running/active.
